records.Title_en: 669543-2026: France – Building construction work – CONSTRUCTION OF A SOCIO-CULTURAL CENTER
records.honorar_erklaerung_en: No fee specified. As this concerns construction works and not separately tendered structural engineering services, an sbp fee cannot be reliably derived from the notice.
records.referenzen_qualifikationen_en: Eligibility criteria according to the tender documents. For Lots 11 and 12, professional qualification certificates are explicitly required. For the other lots, the notice does not specify concrete numbers of references or minimum requirements.
records.baukosten_erklaerung_en: No construction costs stated in the notice. For a reliable estimate, only the total area of 3,176 m², the cultural use, a multipurpose hall with stands, outdoor facilities and enhanced technical equipment are available. From this, a rough estimate in the mid single- to double-digit million range could be derived, but without sufficient certainty for cost groups 300+400.
records.kurzbeschreibung_en: New construction of a socio-cultural center with multipurpose hall, music areas and outdoor facilities.
records.notes_en: Project location near RD 19 and Parc Mary Rose on plots 335 and 342, section AY. The project aims for BDM Silver certification. Free site visit for most lots, mandatory for Lots 1, 2 and 14. Lot 2 allows an optional variant for the foundation system and the load-bearing structure of the multipurpose hall. Lot 11 includes photovoltaics, Lot 12 mentions geothermal energy in the technical memorandum. The notice is labeled as a competition in TED, but in substance it is a works contract in an open procedure.
records.auftraggeber_en: MAIRIE DE GRANS, Grans, France; E-Mail: commandepublique@grans.fr; Vergabeplattform: laprovencemarchespublics.com
records.relevanzbewertung_erklaerung_en:
• Building construction with 3,176 m² and cultural use is fundamentally interesting, but more in the medium size range.
• Positive aspect is Lot 2 with shell construction and steel structure as well as variants for the structure of the multipurpose hall and the foundations.
• The multipurpose hall with retractable stands and auditorium indicates certain structural and acoustic requirements.
• However, the focus is primarily on construction execution, not on structural design or early design involvement.
• No information on large spans, special roof structures or innovative special constructions.
• Sustainability aspect through BDM Silver certification as well as photovoltaics and geothermal energy is positive, but not decisive for the structure.
• For sbp more interesting as a potential partner of an executing company, but overall not a high priority.
records.zuschlagskriterien_en: Varies by lot. Lot 2 shell/steel construction: price 40%, technical and environmental quality 60%. Many other lots: price 60%, quality 40%. Lot 1 also price 60%, quality 40%.
records.leistungen_en: Construction works in 19 lots for the new building; of particular relevance for sbp is Lot 2 shell construction and steel structure. Other lots include, among others, earthworks and utility connections, roof waterproofing, interior fit-out, electrical including photovoltaics, HVAC/sanitary, elevator. For Lot 2, variants for the foundation system and the structure of the multipurpose hall are permitted.
records.umfang_en: New construction of a building with a total area of 3,176 m². It includes a multipurpose hall with retractable stands, areas for cultural associations including a music room, an area for the metropolitan conservatory of music and dance, an area for the municipal leisure center with rooms for children, as well as outdoor facilities with forecourt, secured leisure area, logistics zone, central patio with auditorium and catering area. Additional uses: dining hall, bar, kitchen office, staff apartment, reception hall and technical rooms. Execution period 21 months including 2 months of preparation.
